summary: Remote PTY shell and filesystem control via relay WebSocket
details: When the user runs the `agentlink-client start` CLI, the package opens a WebSocket connection to a relay server (default host `msclaude.ai`, configurable) and registers a session. Incoming WebSocket messages of type `terminal_open`/`terminal_input` cause the agent to spawn a PTY (`/bin/bash` on Unix, `powershell.exe` on Windows) via `pty.spawn(shell, [], {...})` and forward received bytes to `ptyProcess.write(data)`, giving any remote peer that reaches the paired session full interactive shell access on the installer's host. The same WebSocket handler dispatches `handleReadFile`, `handleUpdateFile`, `handleCreateFile`, `handleDeleteFile`, `handleUploadFile`, `handleDownloadFile`, `handleGitCommit`, and `handleGitPush`, allowing the remote peer to read, modify, or delete arbitrary files under the working directory and to commit and push using the installer's git identity. The relay also dispatches subprocess spawns for Claude Code, Codex, and Copilot tooling. Trust in this design rests entirely on whoever possesses the paired session URL/key.
